name: Westfield Santa Anita
description: Westfield Santa Anita is a premier shopping destination in Arcadia, California, featuring a diverse mix of iconic brands including Nike, Apple, Adidas, and Decathlon alongside exceptional dining and entertainment options. Part of Westfield's global portfolio of shopping centers, this location offers both local and international retailers with modern amenities including click-and-collect services and Smart Parking technology. The center serves as a dynamic community hub where visitors can shop, dine, and experience world-class events in a beautifully designed environment.
demographics: Westfield Santa Anita attracts an affluent and ethnically diverse visitor base, drawing heavily from the San Gabriel Valley's upper-middle-class families with median household incomes exceeding $80,000. The trade area includes a significant Asian-American population (50%+) alongside Hispanic and Caucasian demographics, with shoppers ranging from young professionals to families with children. Visitors demonstrate strong brand loyalty and preferences for both mainstream retailers and specialty stores, with frequent visits for both destination shopping and dining experiences. The center benefits from its proximity to the Santa Anita Park racetrack and serves as a regional retail hub for surrounding communities including Pasadena, Temple City, and Monrovia.
summary: Westfield Santa Anita is a premier regional mall in Arcadia offering upscale shopping, dining, and entertainment for the diverse San Gabriel Valley community.
